name: clodeck
description: Remote browser access to Claude Code across multiple project directories

scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build --workspace @clodeck/server && npm run build --workspace @clodeck/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck:tooling && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test:tooling && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently --raw -k "npm run dev --workspace @clodeck/server" "npm run dev --workspace @clodeck/web"
scripts.dev:fake: npm run build:shared && concurrently -k -n server,web -c blue,green "npm run dev:fake --workspace @clodeck/server" "npm run dev --workspace @clodeck/web"
